name: data-sentiment-scale
title: Sentiment Spectrum Shift
description: Kim chỉ trên thang từ âm sang dương trượt bằng lò xo từ −0.30 tới +0.60, vượt quá rồi về, màu và dấu đổi khi qua số 0.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-data-story-sentiment-spectrum, written here): Scale -1..+1 as a 10 px bar, gradient yellow (negative) -> grid grey (0) -> accent (positive), ticks at -1 / -0.5 / 0 / 0.5 / 1. Marker value = -0.30 + 0.90 x spring(t - 0.45 s; stiffness 70, damping 11) (bouncy overshoot), back with a spring (160, 26) at 3.3 s. Marker = 2 px line + triangle + signed tag (+0.60) whose colour flips by sign (grey when |v| < 0.05); a ghost marker at -0.30 fades in 450-700 ms. Params: value (−0.30 → +0.60) · spring (70 / 11) · colors âm / dương.
